page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head centred at the top and the page number at the top right. The catchword sits at the lower right below the last line, and the gathering signature sits at the lower left. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: darunt, ita Cleostratus, Harpalus, Meto, Eudoxus, & Calippus; quam vero in motuum cœlestium observatione infantes fuerint, Ægyptii, Chaldæique omnes, nemo in his rebus mediocriter versatus ignorare potest; cui Græcorum ante Hipparchum infantia perspecta fuerit. Tum enim Græci Ægyptiorum & Chaldæorum adyta omnia penetraverant & Iustraverant, licetque ex Græcorum i-gnoratione Ægyptios & Chaldæos igno-rantiæ convincere. En quam motuum Cœlestium periti, stellarum in occiden-tem motum-non deprehenderant; ideo octavam sphæram primum mobile opi-nabantur, Solem Planetasque cæteros in eccentricis moveri nesciebant. Hinc ab uno æquinoctio ad alterum spatium æquale definiebant, idque non ex specia-li observatione, sed ex solstitiorum com-paratione. Sol tamen deprehensus est ab Hipparcho à verno Æquinoctio ad Au-tumnale octidui, & aliquot horarum spatium amplius, quam in sequenti con-versione consumere. Quid de eorum cir-

page.notes: Catchword "ca-" and signature "Q 7" are printed at the foot. "motum-non" is printed with a connecting stroke that may be a dash or a joined form; read as "motum-non" with some doubt. Long s is rendered as s; u/v and i/j normalised as instructed. "Iustraverant" and "Hipparchum" follow the printed capitals.
